title: A pool whose two issuers sort one way as strkeys and the other as bytes
pattern: Two ARST assets whose issuers order oppositely as strkey text and as raw key bytes. The pool ID and the asset order in the pool use XDR byte order. js-stellar-sdk#1766 compared strkey text and computed the wrong pool ID.

hazards.placement: LiquidityPoolParameters asset order by XDR bytes, not strkey text

facts.says: asset_a is the ARST whose issuer comes first by bytes (GCUXRL…), not first by text (GC7VO2…).
The pool is created with the ID from the byte-ordered parameters.
